B adds explicitly prohibited association fields and broad retry/body-ownership changes.","reasons":["A adds the exact Upload signature and uses multipartbody.NewFile with field \"file\", preserving a replayable *bytes.Reader body.","A preserves Add and avoids B's unrelated Raw.Do retry refactor and changed reader-closing semantics.","B introduces WithFilesFormFields and NewFileWithFields despite the contract explicitly forbidding association fields and requiring reuse of NewFile.","B materially changes Add behavior for all seekable readers, expanding API and ownership semantics beyond the requested convenience upload path."],"risks_a":["Upload duplicates Add's request, decoding, and error logic instead of routing the encoded body through Add as explicitly required.","Tests do not verify uploaded content, Upload retry behavior, validation, or source-reader error propagation; the generic bytes.Reader retry test is weaker than the required streamed-content Upload test.","Validation combines filename and content failures into one less-specific error."],"risks_b":["Upload also bypasses Add, duplicating its request and response logic.","Adds association-form functionality expressly excluded by the contract.","Refactors global request replay and changes whether seekable bodies are closed, creating broad compatibility and concurrency risks unrelated to the task; repeated GetBody calls share one seeker instance rather than independent readers due to io.NopCloser(body). Concurrent or redirected request handling could race or corrupt offsets, and closing semantics differ from net/http expectations and previous SDK behavior. Content-Length probing may also perturb unusual seekers if seeking to end succeeds but later semantics differ. (More concretely, the patch changes caller ownership.) Wait need concise JSON."]}
